follow-up time: Median of 10.0 months between genetic test and RRSO in the RRSO group, and up to 103.8 months in the non-RRSO group
cohort: 117 women with BRCA1/2 mutations who underwent genetic testing at Seoul National University Hospital between 2005 and 2020.
finding: The uptake rate of RRSO in BRCA1/2 mutation carriers was 70.1%, and three incidental cases of high-grade serous carcinoma were found in the RRSO group, highlighting the potential benefits of timely RRSO.
